body.statement: Let \(U\subseteq\mathbb R^n\) be open, let \(F:U\to\mathbb R^n\) be continuously differentiable, and suppose \(DF(x_0)\) is invertible at \(x_0\in U\). Then there are open neighborhoods \(U_0\ni x_0\) and \(V_0\ni F(x_0)\) such that \(F|_{U_0}:U_0\to V_0\) is a continuously differentiable bijection with continuously differentiable inverse.

attestation.note: The stated local diffeomorphism form is the conclusion of Theorem 9.24 in the cited third edition; the bibliography key and stable edition record are supplied here.
